marketplace.name: a-i-skills
marketplace.description: Anthony Padavano's agent skill catalog (4444J99/a-i--skills): original skills plus clearly licensed third-party skills, with provenance and per-skill license declarations.

default_on.rule: A catalog skill is resident in the Claude bundle only if it was invoked in at least one of the host's last 50 Claude sessions (usage), a governing charter names it (charter), or it is the doorway to the on-demand catalog (structural). Every other catalog skill ships in distributions/claude/skills-catalog and loads through skill-catalog. Re-measure with scripts/skill_residency.py usage before changing this list.

closeout.evidence: Invoked in 60 of 104 local Claude sessions (2026-10-16 audit); the Tier-0 CLAUDE.md names the /closeout skill as the close-out procedure.

skill-catalog.evidence: The only route from a session to the on-demand catalog.

voice-enforcement.evidence: The Tier-0 CLAUDE.md names the /voice-enforcement skill as the full voice constitution.
